title: When the Second Agent Actually Buys a Boundary | A Cinematic Research Brief
base_title: When the Second Agent Actually Buys a Boundary
description:
A second agent only earns its keep when it buys a real boundary in memory, authority, or action space.

This cinematic brief strips away the theater around multi-agent systems and focuses on the narrower engineering question: when does another agent create a real boundary instead of more coordination noise?

It should route viewers toward a cleaner decision rule than generic swarm enthusiasm.
